bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 位于 10 至 200 日均线上方，受制于 $271.5–275.3

read.en: Amazon slipped 0.3% on Nov 13 to $266.66, trading $263.91–269.94 on light volume (0.61x the 20-day average). It is just below the 5-day ($267.6) and above the 10-day ($262.0), 30-day ($256.9), 100-day ($254.1) and 200-day ($244.6), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($242.73), and RSI is 57.4.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月13日微跌 0.3%，收于 $266.66，盘中区间 $263.91–269.94，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.61 倍）。股价略低于 5 日均线（$267.6），位于 10 日（$262.0）、30 日（$256.9）、100 日（$254.1）和 200 日均线（$244.6）上方，各均线均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$242.73），RSI 为 57.4。

read.en: No level changed: the $269.94 high stayed under $271.5–275.3 and the $263.91 low held support. Resistance is $271.5–275.3 (recent highs), then $278.6 (May 5 high) and $287.2 (52-week high). Support is $263.9–265.6 (Nov 4, 11 and 13 lows), then $258.5–262.0 (Nov 6 low, 10-day) and $254.1–256.9 (100 and 30-day). A close above $275.3 would target $278.6; below $263.9, $258.5–262.
